question: What claim is made about the transmission of the practice of the soul to the addressed one?
premises: This practice of the soul is addressed to you.
It is said to have been told to you.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
